title: Sweep the words agents read: models.<runtime> becomes team.<runtime>
action:
88 user-facing strings in non-test Rust still name `models.<runtime>` (find them with `rg -n 'models\.(claude|codex|pi|opencode|<runtime>|<rt>|\{)' packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src --glob '*.rs' | grep -v '/tests\|tests.rs'`). The decisive ones: the dispatch-door line printed into every session preamble (`hooks/model_guard.rs:542`), the guard's refusal (`:293-297`), `verbs/drivers/models.rs:489`, the pi refusals at `verbs/drivers/prepare.rs:143,147`, fifteen `bee status` problem messages in `verbs/status_full/store.rs` (:529, :543, :558, :588, :606, :625, :638, :651, :664, :677, :689, :716, :727, :738, :761, :775), `doctor.rs:337`, the addCell refusal that teaches the key at `verbs/cells/validate.rs:362`, the `TEACH` constant at `verbs/models_group.rs:48`, and the porcelain line at `router.rs:86`.

Change every one from `models.<...>` to `team.<...>`. Where a string says `bee models show`, make it `bee team show`. Then update every test that asserts the old wording verbatim — known ones at `model_guard.rs:2653, 2719, 2735, 2879, 2885, 2914, 3152` and `models_group.rs:456` (`assert!(text.contains("models.<runtime>.<role>"))`); find the rest by running the suite.

Do NOT touch `docs/`, `skills/`, or `.bee/config.json` — those are slice 2. Do NOT rename the `bee status --json` OUTPUT key `models` (`status_full/build.rs:339-344`) — it is a public contract and stays. Do NOT touch the string literal `"models"` used as a JSON KEY in code — only prose that a human or agent reads.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee && ! rg -n 'models\.(claude|codex|pi|opencode|<runtime>|<rt>|\{)' packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src --glob '*.rs' | grep -v '/tests\|tests.rs' | grep -q .
